title: Double Drop
description: Stop knocking your Q key with double drop!
body:
Double Drop is a lightweight plugin that changes how item dropping works:
- **Double-Q to drop:** Players must press `Q` twice quickly to drop an item. Prevents accidental item loss.
- **Toggle Mode:** Players can enable or disable double drop with `/toggledrop`.
- **Configurable Timeout:** Adjust the allowed time between presses in `config.yml`.
- **Persistant Settings:** Double Drop saves toggle states across server restarts.
- **Compatible with many versions:** Double Drop is compatible with many versions.

I made double drop as I was constantly knocking my Q key and dropping items when I didn't want to. It helps me now, so I hope it helps you too!
